title: Dose Banding Algorithm
description:
Generates standardised chemotherapy dose bands with a guaranteed tolerance bound, in a format that imports directly into a CPOE standardised dose range table.

For every configuration it accepts, the generated table is verified to satisfy three properties before being returned: dispensability (every band dose is a whole number of syringe graduations for its own volume tier), tolerance (every prescribed dose in range receives a band dose within ±6% for traditional cytotoxics or ±10% for monoclonal antibodies, judged at the published boundaries), and coverage (the bands tile the requested range with no gap and no overlap). Where the guarantee cannot be met, the algorithm raises rather than emitting a table that breaches tolerance.

Tag v1.0 is the state of the algorithm described in the accompanying manuscript. Later tags add whole-vial optimisation, which is outside the scope of that paper and does not alter band generation when no vial sizes are supplied.
notes: Developed without funding. Not a medical device: any generated table must be reviewed and approved by a qualified pharmacist against local policy before clinical use.
